items.source: Consider extending AbstractRequestCondition for custom condition types and using CompositeRequestCondition to provide multiple custom conditions.
items.translation: 考虑扩展 AbstractRequestCondition 以支持自定义条件类型，并使用 CompositeRequestCondition 来提供多个自定义条件。

items.source: The custom RequestCondition can be of any type so long as the same condition type is returned from all calls to this method in order to ensure custom request conditions can be combined and compared.
items.translation: 自定义的 RequestCondition 可以是任意类型，只要此方法的所有调用都返回相同的条件类型，以确保可以组合和比较自定义请求条件。

items.source: Create a RequestMappingInfo from the supplied @HttpExchange annotation, meta-annotation, or synthesized result of merging annotation attributes within an annotation hierarchy.

items.source: Prefixes are used to enrich the mappings of every @RequestMapping method and @HttpExchange method whose controller type is matched by a corresponding Predicate in the map. The prefix for the first matching predicate is used, assuming the input map has predictable order.
items.translation: 前缀用于丰富每个由映射中的相应 `` 匹配的控制器类型的 `@RequestMapping` 方法和 `@HttpExchange` 方法的映射。假设输入映射具有可预测的顺序，则使用第一个匹配的前缀。
